name: StoreSEO
summary: SEO suite for Shopify: bulk meta titles and descriptions, image compression and alt text, JSON-LD schema, sitemap submission, instant indexing requests and Search Console reporting, with AI credits for generated copy.
best_for: Shopify stores with a few hundred products and no in-house SEO help, who want metadata, schema, alt text and indexing handled in bulk and reported against Search Console
skip_if: you have fewer than 25 products, in which case the free tier is the whole product, or you expect an app to fix a demand problem rather than a metadata one
honest_knock: Know what an SEO app can and cannot do before you buy any tier. This one fixes the mechanical layer well: meta titles and descriptions in bulk, alt text, compressed images, JSON-LD, sitemaps, indexing requests, and none of that creates demand for products nobody is searching for. It is maintenance, not marketing, and on a catalogue of 25 products the free tier already does most of it. Two specifics worth a raised eyebrow. The pricing gap between Essential at $39.99 for 250 products and Advanced at $249.99 for 10,000 is filled by a $99.99 Growth plan. That plan lives on the vendor's own site but not on the App Store listing our link points to, which is a strange place to hide a tier. And the AEO/GEO features: the LLMs.txt generator, the Agents.md editor, the separate “agentic” ranking: are a bet, not a channel. No major search or AI vendor has committed to reading llms.txt, so treat those numbers as a hypothesis you are testing rather than traffic you are buying.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-19 on apps.shopify.com/storeseo, re-verified 2026-09-28 and 2026-11-12; Lite was repriced in between) Free Forever covers 25 products with SEO scoring, 200 AI credits, 25 image optimisations, up to 5 tracked keywords, an LLMs.txt generator and Agents.md editor, an SEO migrator, alt-text optimisation and 24/7 chat support. Paid tiers are Lite $19.99, Essential $39.99 and Advanced $249.99 a month, each with a 7-day free trial. Lite was $14.99 a month in our readings from 19 August to 28 September 2026; on 12 November the listing and the plan cards on storeseo.com both show $19.99, while the comparison table lower on storeseo.com still prints $14.99. Until 1 December 2026 a Black Friday offer takes 80% off the first month of every paid plan: $3.99 for Lite, $7.99 for Essential, $19.99 for Growth and $49.99 for Advanced, then the regular price. Lite covers 100 products, 500 image optimisations and 1,000 AI credits and adds one-click schema markup, instant indexing requests, Google Analytics and Search Console and automatic sitemap submission. Essential covers 250 products, 2,000 images and 5,000 credits. Advanced covers 10,000 products, 50,000 images, 50,000 credits and adds multilingual SEO. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Worth knowing: storeseo.com sells a Growth plan at $99.99 a month (1,000 products, 5,000 images, 12,500 AI credits, 200 keywords) that does not appear on the App Store listing at all, and also sells credit top-ups from $10 for 5,000 credits, $50 for 25,000 and $100 for 50,000. Rating 5.0 from 773 App Store reviews on 12 November 2026 (753 on 28 September, 674 on 19 August). Developer Storeware, Milton, Delaware; the app launched 19 October 2021 and carries Shopify's “Built for Shopify” badge.

measured.tested_by: Our team; actor, account and scope are documented in the review.
method: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser
Evidence screenshots are in English with names and addresses masked

claims.observed: The scan of 20 products took 13 seconds and gave a score of 44, with 19 of 20 meta titles, 20 of 20 meta descriptions and 20 of 20 product descriptions marked as needing work and 0 of 18 images missing alt text; no fix was run.
claims.plan: Lite approval screen, not approved, development store
claims.comparability: Dossier pain of weak meta tags versus one scan of 20 products on a development store; no fix was applied.
claims.buying_consequence: The app finds the missing or weak meta titles and descriptions of a store quickly; what a fix produces was not tried.

claims.claim: Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial.
claims.observed: The plan step says every plan starts with a 7-day free trial, but the Subscribe path for Lite showed a first charge of $3,99 due 17 Nov on the Shopify screen with no trial; the link Try free for 7 days was not used.
claims.plan: Lite approval screen, not approved, development store
claims.comparability: Plan step line on a 7-day trial versus the Lite approval screen with a charge due the same day.
claims.buying_consequence: The trial may exist only on another path; on the path used a payment method was needed at once.

claims.observed: Growth is a card in the app, $19.99 for the first month and then $99.99 a month, although the dossier says the $99.99 Growth plan is sold only on the vendor's own site.
claims.plan: Lite approval screen, not approved, development store
claims.comparability: Dossier remark on a vendor-site-only Growth plan versus the Growth card in the app.
claims.buying_consequence: A buyer can pick Growth inside the app, so the dossier line that it is vendor-site only is out of date.

claims.observed: Lite is $3.99 for the first month with the code BFCM2026 (80% off, $16.00) and then $19.99 a month, as the dossier says for Lite; the Black Friday price is a first-month price only.
claims.plan: Lite approval screen, not approved, development store
claims.comparability: Dossier Lite price versus the card and checkout dialog; the discount applies to one month.
claims.buying_consequence: The regular Lite price is $19.99 a month; the first month is cheaper during the Black Friday offer.

claims.observed: Essential is $7.99 for the first month and then $39.99 a month with 250 products and 5,000 credits, as the dossier says.
claims.plan: Lite approval screen, not approved, development store
claims.comparability: Dossier Essential price versus the Essential card; its checkout was opened by accident and closed.
claims.buying_consequence: The regular Essential price is $39.99 a month.

claims.observed: The Shopify approval screen shows Lite at $19,99 reduced to $3,99 USD every 30 days with a total of $3,99 due 17 Nov plus any applicable taxes, no trial and no test charge sentence; Add payment method was needed, Approve was greyed out and nothing was approved.
claims.plan: Lite approval screen, not approved, development store
claims.comparability: Plan card price versus the approval screen with no tax line; no stored cost rule was compared.
claims.buying_consequence: Lite costs $3,99 today and $19,99 after the discount month, plus any taxes, with no trial on this path.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested StoreSEO on a Shopify development store: the install, one scan of 20 products that took 13 seconds and gave a score of 44 (19 of 20 meta titles and all 20 meta descriptions need work), no fix, the plan step with the Black Friday offer and all four plans including Growth, and the Lite checkout, where the Shopify approval screen showed $3,99 due 17 Nov, asked to add a payment method and had no test charge sentence. Nothing was approved or paid, the Free plan was not looked at, and the app was uninstalled afterwards. Install: the App Store listing (English) was opened at 18:16, the install form was submitted in our own tab, and the Shopify dialog Install app asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data; Install was clicked at about 18:17. The app opened on a short start with the text that it was ready to scan the store and the buttons I want free SEO consultation, Detailed documentation guides, Full walkthrough and Analyze My Store; only Analyze My Store was used. The footer says Version: 4.1.7. No account on the vendor site, password, card or phone number was asked and no Google account was connected. The admin was in English. Core action, one SEO scan of the store: Analyze My Store was clicked once at about 18:17 and the result stood there at about 18:18. The progress line said Scan Progress 13 sec 100% Complete, with the steps Scanning Product and Analyzing SEO Score (Meta Title, Image Alt Text, Meta Description, Product Description, Focus Keyword Density, Optimized Images). The result: Your Current SEO Score is: 44; I've analyzed 20 products from your catalog; 19 of 20 Meta titles need work; 20 of 20 Meta descriptions need work; 20 of 20 Product descriptions need work; 0 of 18 Images missing alt text. Under Fix your first product the lowest products were The Hidden Snowboard (Not Optimized, Score 31), Harbour Tour Test (37), The Complete Snowboard (37), The Multi-managed Snowboard (38) and The Compare at Price Snowboard (38). No fix was run, Fix SEO score was not used and nothing was saved. Time from install to the scan result: about 1 to 2 minutes and 2 steps (install, Analyze My Store). Plans: Skip setup led to the plan step, Fix your 20 products with AI, Pick a plan. Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial., with a banner Grab Your First Month Black Friday Deal, Flat 80% OFF. In the app: Lite $3.99 the first month, then $19.99 a month (100 products, 500 images, 1,000 AI content credits, 50 keywords rank tracking); Essential $7.99, then $39.99 (250 products, 2,000 images, 5,000 credits, 100 keywords, AI Brand Analysis); Growth $19.99, then $99.99 (1,000 products, 5,000 images, 12,500 credits, 200 keywords, AI Brand Analysis, Multilingual SEO); Advanced $49.99, then $249.99 (10,000 products, 50,000 images, 50,000 credits, 1,000 keywords, AI Brand Analysis, Multilingual SEO). The buttons are Continue with FREE, Try free for 7 days and Subscribe. The Free plan was not chosen or looked at. Difference with the dossier: the dossier says the $99.99 Growth plan is sold only on the vendor's own site; in the app Growth is a card with $19.99 for the first month and $99.99 a month after that. The Black Friday offer in the app uses the code BFCM2026 for 80% off the first month. Checkout: by accident the checkout of Essential was opened first (it was preselected) and closed without paying. Then Lite was chosen and the dialog Checkout: Lite showed Plan Price $19.99, Duration 1 month, Sub Total $19.99, Discount BFCM2026 -$16.00 (applied 80% discount for the next 1 month, after that the regular price applies) and Total $3.99; Subscribe now was clicked. The Shopify screen Approve subscription then showed Lite, 1000 AI Credits, 500 Images, $19,99 $3,99 USD every 30 days, Your next bill Subtotal $19,99 plus any applicable taxes, Discount $16,00 and Total $3,99 Due 17 Nov, a row Add payment method and a greyed out Approve button. There was no free trial on this path and the sentence about a test charge was NOT on the screen. A payment method had to be added, so nothing was approved; no card was entered and the screen was closed with Cancel. The link Try free for 7 days was not used. Cancelling: no subscription was started, so nothing could be cancelled. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the menu of the app and Uninstall; the app was uninstalled after the test. Not tested: a fix of one product, the bulk AI fix, the Free plan after Continue with FREE, the 7-day trial path, Google Search Console and Analytics, schema, the sitemap, LLMs.txt, the MCP connector, buying credits and a refund. Clean up: no subscription was made, no theme change was saved and no product was changed; the app was uninstalled; our own tabs were closed. The clock times in the notes can be a few minutes off. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The Lite checkout asked to add a payment method with no test charge sentence and no trial although the plan step says every plan starts with a 7-day free trial; the Growth plan is in the app although the dossier says it is only on the vendor site; the preselected Essential checkout opened by accident; and no fix was tried, so the result of a fix is unknown.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested StoreSEO on a Shopify development store: the install, one scan of 20 products that took 13 seconds and gave a score of 44 (19 of 20 meta titles and all 20 meta descriptions need work), no fix, the plan step with the Black Friday offer and all four plans including Growth, and the Lite checkout, where the Shopify approval screen showed $3,99 due 17 Nov, asked to add a payment method and had no test charge sentence. Nothing was approved or paid, the Free plan was not looked at, and the app was uninstalled afterwards. Install: the App Store listing (English) was opened at 18:16, the install form was submitted in our own tab, and the Shopify dialog Install app asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data; Install was clicked at about 18:17. The app opened on a short start with the text that it was ready to scan the store and the buttons I want free SEO consultation, Detailed documentation guides, Full walkthrough and Analyze My Store; only Analyze My Store was used. The footer says Version: 4.1.7. No account on the vendor site, password, card or phone number was asked and no Google account was connected. The admin was in English. Core action, one SEO scan of the store: Analyze My Store was clicked once at about 18:17 and the result stood there at about 18:18. The progress line said Scan Progress 13 sec 100% Complete, with the steps Scanning Product and Analyzing SEO Score (Meta Title, Image Alt Text, Meta Description, Product Description, Focus Keyword Density, Optimized Images). The result: Your Current SEO Score is: 44; I've analyzed 20 products from your catalog; 19 of 20 Meta titles need work; 20 of 20 Meta descriptions need work; 20 of 20 Product descriptions need work; 0 of 18 Images missing alt text. Under Fix your first product the lowest products were The Hidden Snowboard (Not Optimized, Score 31), Harbour Tour Test (37), The Complete Snowboard (37), The Multi-managed Snowboard (38) and The Compare at Price Snowboard (38). No fix was run, Fix SEO score was not used and nothing was saved. Time from install to the scan result: about 1 to 2 minutes and 2 steps (install, Analyze My Store). Plans: Skip setup led to the plan step, Fix your 20 products with AI, Pick a plan. Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial., with a banner Grab Your First Month Black Friday Deal, Flat 80% OFF. In the app: Lite $3.99 the first month, then $19.99 a month (100 products, 500 images, 1,000 AI content credits, 50 keywords rank tracking); Essential $7.99, then $39.99 (250 products, 2,000 images, 5,000 credits, 100 keywords, AI Brand Analysis); Growth $19.99, then $99.99 (1,000 products, 5,000 images, 12,500 credits, 200 keywords, AI Brand Analysis, Multilingual SEO); Advanced $49.99, then $249.99 (10,000 products, 50,000 images, 50,000 credits, 1,000 keywords, AI Brand Analysis, Multilingual SEO). The buttons are Continue with FREE, Try free for 7 days and Subscribe. The Free plan was not chosen or looked at. Difference with the dossier: the dossier says the $99.99 Growth plan is sold only on the vendor's own site; in the app Growth is a card with $19.99 for the first month and $99.99 a month after that. The Black Friday offer in the app uses the code BFCM2026 for 80% off the first month. Checkout: by accident the checkout of Essential was opened first (it was preselected) and closed without paying. Then Lite was chosen and the dialog Checkout: Lite showed Plan Price $19.99, Duration 1 month, Sub Total $19.99, Discount BFCM2026 -$16.00 (applied 80% discount for the next 1 month, after that the regular price applies) and Total $3.99; Subscribe now was clicked. The Shopify screen Approve subscription then showed Lite, 1000 AI Credits, 500 Images, $19,99 $3,99 USD every 30 days, Your next bill Subtotal $19,99 plus any applicable taxes, Discount $16,00 and Total $3,99 Due 17 Nov, a row Add payment method and a greyed out Approve button. There was no free trial on this path and the sentence about a test charge was NOT on the screen. A payment method had to be added, so nothing was approved; no card was entered and the screen was closed with Cancel. The link Try free for 7 days was not used. Cancelling: no subscription was started, so nothing could be cancelled. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the menu of the app and Uninstall; the app was uninstalled after the test. Not tested: a fix of one product, the bulk AI fix, the Free plan after Continue with FREE, the 7-day trial path, Google Search Console and Analytics, schema, the sitemap, LLMs.txt, the MCP connector, buying credits and a refund. Clean up: no subscription was made, no theme change was saved and no product was changed; the app was uninstalled; our own tabs were closed. The clock times in the notes can be a few minutes off. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The Lite checkout asked to add a payment method with no test charge sentence and no trial although the plan step says every plan starts with a 7-day free trial; the Growth plan is in the app although the dossier says it is only on the vendor site; the preselected Essential checkout opened by accident; and no fix was tried, so the result of a fix is unknown.
